Cloud Storage

Store documents on configurable cloud backends.

Supported providers

  • Amazon S3
  • Azure Blob Storage
  • Google Cloud Storage
  • Local disk

Configuration

Set the storage driver in .env:

FILESYSTEM_DISK=s3
